hero.title: Christmas at sea, all nine of you.
hero.subtitle: 4 days, 3 nights in the Sea of Cortez, December 25 to 28. One boat, two families, and a crew that takes care of everything else.

brief.title: What you asked for
brief.text:
Everyone on the same boat. Four rooms set up the way your families sleep: grandparents, mother and daughter, parents, and the three sisters. And a finish in La Paz with the afternoon free for the road to Los Cabos.

That's the brief. Here is how we'd do it.

facts.text: Day 1, Dec 25: check-in at the marina, 9:00

days.title: Four days, no unbreakable agenda
days.text:
We leave La Paz on Christmas morning and head for Espíritu Santo, the island in front of the city. The route is decided each morning with the captain, by wind and sea.

At Los Islotes, at the north end of the island, a colony of sea lions lives on the rocks. The young ones come to play with snorkelers in the water.

The bays of Ensenada Grande and Caleta Partida are where we usually anchor for the night: white sand, turquoise water and no one else around after sunset.

On the way back, Balandra: shallow water you can walk across, and the mushroom-shaped rock everyone photographs.

In between: paddle boards, kayak, snorkel straight off the boat, and long lunches at anchor.
days.note: Final route set by the captain according to weather and sea conditions.

dive.title: For those who want to go deeper
dive.text: Alexis, your Expedition Leader, is a dive instructor. Anyone in the group who wants to try scuba for the first time can do a first dive with him, no experience needed. Certified divers can dive with him too. Let us know before the trip so we bring the equipment.

boat.title: Fountaine Pajot Saona 47
boat.intro: A private catamaran with five cabins, each with its own bathroom. Captain, chef, deckhand and our Expedition Leader on board.
boat.priceNote: Price for the full boat and the full group, valid for 48 hours from the date of this proposal. Choose one of the two options for payment and communicate it to our agent to receive the details.

food.title: What's cooking on board
food.text: Your chef shops in La Paz the day before you board and cooks three meals a day on board: breakfast on deck, lunch at anchor, dinner as the sun goes down. Tell us about allergies or preferences before the trip and the menu is built around them.

aboard.title: What's aboard
onBoard: Alexis, your Expedition Leader and dive instructor, with you all four days
All meals on board and non-alcoholic drinks
Fuel, navigation and national park permits
Dinghy, 2 paddle boards, double kayak, inflatable platform, snorkel gear for everyone
BBQ, beach shade, chairs and towels
notOnBoard: Alcohol (bring your own, or ask us about our wine selection)
Crew tips (10% of the trip value is customary)
Scuba diving or kite surfing equipment and tanks (on request, book before the trip)

crew.title: The people running the boat
crew.text:
The captain reads the sea. The chef cooks with what Baja has that week. The deckhand handles the dinghy and the anchor. And your Expedition Leader reads the group: when to swim, when to sail, when to leave everyone alone with a coffee on the bow.

You bring the people. We take care of the rest.

leader.name: Alexis
leader.text: Alexis grew up in Chile and spent years in luxury hospitality (Ritz-Carlton & Mandarin Oriental) before the sea became his work. On board he reads the group: who wants to swim at seven, who wants a slow coffee, who's ready to try a first dive. He'll speak French with one family, Italian with the other, and Spanish with the crew.

book.title: How to book
book.text: Christmas dates go fast and the boat is held only once we receive the deposit. These are the terms:
terms: Bank transfer price: payment in USD to the Eagle Ray Expeditions US account. 50% on confirmation and 50% before November 23, or 100% on confirmation.
Card price: payment through a secure payment link. 50% on confirmation and 50% before November 23, or 100% on confirmation. Card processing fees are non-refundable.
This proposal is valid for 48 hours.
Cancellation: 50% of the amount paid is refunded for cancellations before November 24. From November 24, payments are non-refundable.
Weather: if conditions prevent leaving port, we extend the lost day when the boat's schedule allows. If not, we refund USD 1,600 for each full day lost.

closing.title: Ready when you are
closing.text: Tell us how you'd like to pay, and we'll send the booking details the same day.
